answer_1.quote: Recent studies have revealed that neural machine translation (NMT) ... is fragile when attacked ... we focus on crafting word level adversarial examples ... In this work, we introduce new definition and metrics for the machine translation adversaries ... We propose a promising black-box attack method called Word Saliency speedup Local Search (WSLS) that could effectively attack the mainstream NMT architectures, e.g. RNN and Transformer.
answer_1.outputs: adversarial source sentences (perturbed Chinese/English inputs) and their degraded translations

answer_2.quote: In this work, we use the BLEU score to evaluate the similarity between two sentences. Based on Definition 2, we further provide two metrics, i.e., Mean Decrease (MD) and Mean Percentage Decrease (MPD) to estimate the translation adversaries appropriately.
